text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Top Road has seized the victory! 
Claiming the Arima Kinen, she lets out a 
triumphant roar. Channeling everyone's 
expectations into strength, she pulled it 
off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She expresses her gratitude to the members 
of the Golden Generation who stood as her 
rivals, to the peers she honed her skills 
with along the way— and to the Trainer who 
walked beside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Top Road stood at the 
summit. Yet the road does not end here. 
The path of light stretches beyond the 
peak, continuing on into the far distance—
